mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guestbook_tbl ( user_id, guestbook_content, guestbook_secret ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{guestbookContent}, #{guestbookSecret} )
mapper.select: SELECT is_block FROM user_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT g.guestbook_id AS guestbookId, g.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, g.guestbook_content AS guestbookContent, g.guestbook_secret AS guestbookSecret, g.guestbook_date AS guestbookDate, g.answer_content AS answerContent, g.answer_date AS answerDate FROM guestbook_tbl g JOIN user_tbl u ON g.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY g.guestbook_date DESC, g.guestbook_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT user_id FROM guestbook_tbl WHERE guestbook_id = #{guestbookId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_tbl SET is_block = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_role = 'USER' AND is_block = FALSE
